BETA Close X Associated British Foods plc announced on August 3, 2026, that it repurchased 40,000 of its ordinary shares for cancellation from Barclays Capital Securities Limited. The average price paid per share was GBp 2121.8957, with the highest price at GBp 2135.0000 and the lowest at GBp 2092.0000. This transaction was conducted on the London Stock Exchange as part of the company's ongoing share repurchase program. Disclaimer* Associated British Foods PLC 03 August 2026 03 August 2026 Associated British Foods plc Transaction in own shares Associated British Foods plc (the " Company ") announces that on 03 August 2026 it purchased for cancellation from Barclays Capital Securities Limited (" Barclays ") the following number of its ordinary shares of 5 15/22 pence each pursuant to the authority granted by its shareholders as part of its share repurchase programme, details of which were announced on 25 February 2026. Description of shares: Associated British Foods plc Ordinary shares of 5 15/22 pence Date of transaction: 03 August 2026 Number of shares repurchased: 40,000 Average price paid per share: GBp 2121.8957 Highest price paid per share: GBp 2135.0000 Lowest price paid per share: GBp 2092.0000 The Company intends to cancel these Shares. All shares were purchased from Barclays as an on exchange transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange.
